contents.contents: Complete canonical Hours for Passion Week, Vespers, Compline, Midnight, Lauds, Terce, Sext and None (ܪܡܫܐ، ܣܘܬܪܐ، ܠܠܝܐ، ܨܦܪܐ، ܬܠܬܫܥܝ̈ܢ، ܫܬܫܥܝ̈ܢ ܘܬܫܥܫܥ̈ܝܢ) for : Monday, fol. 1r-41r; Tuesday, fol. 41r-78r; Wednesday, fol. 78r-119v; Thursday with the washing of feets rite (ܫܝܓܬܐ), fol. 119v-165r; Friday with the Good Friday rite (ܣܓܕܬܐ), fol. 165r-230v and Saturday with rite of forgiveness (ܕܫܘܒܩܢܐ) fol. 230v-274v
